name: az-en-kutyaiskolam
description: Az Én Kutyaiskolám (Miskolc) weboldala: React kliens, Node.js backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w client
